{title}

{body}

Discussion Points

{points}
""" def create_forum_post(topic: str, text_body: str, points: list[str]) -> str: """ Construct a sanitized HTML representation of a forum post. Parameters ---------- topic : str The title or main topic of the forum post. text_body : str The main body or content of the forum post. points : list[str] A collection of user‑provided discussion points or options in markdown format. Returns ------- str The fully formatted and sanitized HTML representation of the forum post. """ # Basic validation and type coercion if topic is None: topic = "" if text_body is None: text_body = "" # Escape user supplied strings to prevent HTML injection escaped_title = html.escape(str(topic), quote=True) escaped_body = html.escape(str(text_body), quote=True) # Build the list of discussion points, escaping each entry if not isinstance(points, (list, tuple)): points = [] list_items = [] for point in points: # Ensure the point is a string and escape it safe_point = html.escape(str(point), quote=True) list_items.append(f"
  • {safe_point}
    • ") # If no points are provided, we still include an empty list to keep structure if not list_items: points_html = "
      " else: points_html = f"
        {''.join(list_items)}
      " # Construct the final HTML using the template formatted_post = FORUM_POST_FORMAT.format( title=escaped_title, body=escaped_body, points=points_html ) return formatted_post.strip()
